question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**have**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**have**'.
 
• We know that after '**did**' the base form of the **verb** is used.
 
• Here, '**have**' is the base form of the **verb**.
 
• It means** 'to own or to hold something; to possess'. **(किसी वस्‍तु का मालिक होना या किसी बात का अधिकारी होना; किसी वस्‍तु पर अधिकार रखना)
 
 
• *Example: Dogs **have** better personalities than cats.*

 
 
 

**Correct Paragraph:__** *Namita did not have enough cash. She did not __**have**__ a credit card either. She found herself in a (2) ______ . She had the contact number of a (3) ______ friend whom she called for help. Her friend came (4) ______ and settled the bill. Namita thanked her and expressed her (5) _______ . She promised to return the money to her friend soon.*

47:Td34,

The correct answer is **'fix'**.
